data.name: EndpointUrl_Option
data.value: OPC UA endpoint URL (opc.tcp://localhost:4840/SszDcsCentralServer; localhost is replaced by the host name)

data.name: SystemNameToConnect_Option
data.value: System name to connect (DCS or process modeling session name)

data.name: SecurityPolicies_Option
data.value: Security policies, comma separated (None, Basic256Sha256, Aes128_Sha256_RsaOaep, Aes256_Sha256_RsaPss)

data.name: UserName_Option
data.value: User name for username/password authentication (empty - disabled)

data.name: PkiDirectory_Option
data.value: Certificate stores directory (own, trusted, issuer, rejected)

data.name: IdleUnsubscribeSeconds_Option
data.value: Seconds of inactivity after which a tag without monitored items is unsubscribed

data.name: Status_ServerFailed
data.value: OPC UA server failed to start

data.name: Status_DataAccessProviderIsNotConnected
data.value: OPC UA server is running, data source is not connected
